full_name: William F. Pirl | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 Medicine Helen Putnam Fellow Massachusetts General Hospital, Harvard Medical School
bio: William F. Pirl is an associate professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School and director of the Center for Psychiatric Oncology and Behavioral Sciences at Massachusetts General Hospital. He is a clinician-researcher who focuses on the relationship between depression and survival in patients with metastatic lung cancer.
